notes: PRIMARY SOURCE: the club's own scorecard PDF linked from tarandowah.ca/links (DOWNLOAD SCORECARD -> /wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Scorecard-Web.pdf, generated 2026-04-30). Every per-hole yardage, par and stroke index below was read off that card and all five tee totals reconcile exactly to the printed OUT/IN/TOT figures. Par is a single row on the card (70) applying to all five tees, including Red. STROKE INDEX: front nine carries the even indexes (14,10,16,6,2,12,18,4,8) and back nine the odd (11,1,15,13,5,17,3,9,7) - unusual but complete 1-18. Independently confirmed hole-for-hole by offcourse.co. HOWEVER Golf Canada's own facility record and BlueGolf both carry an OLDER allocation (1:11, 2:9, 3:17, 4:7, 5:1, 6:13, 7:15, 8:5, 9:3, 10:12, 11:2, 12:16, 13:14, 14:4, 15:18, 16:10, 17:8, 18:6). Golf Canada's tee records are all flagged isActive=false (stale), so the current printed card was preferred, but if the app posts scores to Golf Canada the stroke allocation there may differ. YARDAGE DISAGREEMENTS: Black tee is corroborated at 7067 (official card + offcourse + the club's 2025 yardage guide, which sums to 7067) but Golf Canada and BlueGolf list Black at 7038 with slightly different per-hole numbers (e.g. hole 1 = 380 not 387), an older measurement. The Gold/Blue/White/Red decks were evidently moved between the 2025 yardage guide and the 2026 card (e.g. 2025 guide has Blue hole 8 = 379, the 2026 card has 413); the 2026 card is used throughout. RATINGS: the five rating/slope pairs are taken from the colour-swatch legend printed at the foot of the official card (Black 74.5/137, Gold 72.2/129, Blue 70.1/125, White 68.6/122, Red 71.7/121); offcourse.co carries the identical set of values. Caveat: those ratings appear to predate the current forward-tee yardages - offcourse ties 70.1/125 to a 6203-yard set and 68.6/122 to a 5896-yard set, whereas the current card prints Blue 6327 and White 5775, so the club has carried old ratings onto re-measured decks. Golf Canada's archived record instead shows Black 74.2/130, Gold 72.3/127, Blue 70.2/123, White 68.8/122, Red 66.2/116 men / 71.6/124 women. LOCATION: the request said Mossley, Ontario; the club's own address is 15125 Putnam Rd, Springfield ON N0L 2J0 (some listings say Avon). Mossley is a nearby hamlet - same course, only one Tarandowah exists.
